title: UraiEcmaConfig
description: Configuration schema for urai-ecma: AST commentary, pruning, and LLM context packaging engine for ECMAScript codebases (உரை - explanation & distillation).

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON schema definition for IDE validation and autocompletion.

input_project.title: Input Project Path
input_project.description: Path to the project directory or single source file to be processed.
input_project.markdownDescription:
Path to the target **project root directory** or a **single source file** to analyze.

*Supports relative paths (e.g. `./src`) and absolute paths.*

output_file.title: Output File Path
output_file.description: Target output file path for the generated Markdown documentation.
output_file.markdownDescription:
Destination path for the generated **Markdown documentation file**.

*Must end with `.md`, `.markdown`, `.mdx` or `.txt`.*

ollama_endpoint.title: Ollama Endpoint URL
ollama_endpoint.description: Local or remote Ollama server API base URL.
ollama_endpoint.markdownDescription:
Base URL of the **Ollama server** (e.g., `http://localhost:11434`). Required when AI summarization features are enabled.

*Default:* `http://localhost:11434`

ollama_modelname.title: Ollama Model Name
ollama_modelname.description: Ollama model identifier to use for analysis and summarization tasks.
ollama_modelname.markdownDescription:
Identifier of the local **Ollama model** used for AST summarization and styling inference.

*Default:* `gemma4`

tailwind_mode.title: Tailwind CSS Pruning Mode
tailwind_mode.description: Strategy for pruning or summarizing Tailwind CSS / className strings to optimize token consumption.
tailwind_mode.markdownDescription:
Strategy for pruning or condensing **Tailwind CSS utility classes** in JSX/TSX/HTML components to optimize LLM token usage:

- `remove`: Strips static utility class strings exceeding `tailwind_threshold` while preserving dynamic expressions.
- `remove_aggr`: Aggressively strips static class strings regardless of length.
- `summarize`: Sends utility classes exceeding `tailwind_threshold` to Ollama for a 1-line semantic style summary.
- `preserve`: Keeps all class names completely untouched.
enumDescriptions: Strips static class strings exceeding threshold while keeping dynamic expressions.
Aggressively removes class strings even if below character threshold.
Sends class strings exceeding threshold to Ollama for 1-line style descriptions.
markdownEnumDescriptions: **`remove`**: Strips static class strings exceeding `tailwind_threshold` while keeping dynamic expressions.
**`remove_aggr`**: Aggressively removes class strings even if below character threshold.
**`summarize`**: Sends class strings exceeding `tailwind_threshold` to Ollama for 1-line style descriptions.

tailwind_threshold.title: Tailwind Character Threshold
tailwind_threshold.description: Character length threshold to trigger Tailwind pruning.
tailwind_threshold.markdownDescription:
Character length threshold for static `className` strings. If a class string exceeds this length, it is pruned or summarized based on `tailwind_mode`.

*Default:* `96`

summarize_functions.title: Summarize Functions
summarize_functions.description: Summarize function block bodies using local Ollama or fallback to JSDoc comments.
summarize_functions.markdownDescription:
When enabled, large function bodies are summarized using Ollama or extracted JSDoc comments, reducing AST token density.

*Default:* `true`

summarize_functions_threshold.title: Function Summarization Line Threshold
summarize_functions_threshold.description: Line count threshold to trigger function summarization.
summarize_functions_threshold.markdownDescription:
The minimum number of source lines a function must span to trigger LLM/JSDoc summarization.

*Default:* `5`

generate_route_table.title: Generate Route Table
generate_route_table.description: Extract and generate an API Route Table from Express, Fastify, Next.js, and NestJS source files.
generate_route_table.markdownDescription:
Scans ASTs to extract API routes (Express, Fastify, Next.js App/Pages router, NestJS) and outputs a markdown table.

*Default:* `true`

analyze_react_components.title: Analyze React Components
analyze_react_components.description: Analyze React and React Native components and output detailed explanations.
analyze_react_components.markdownDescription:
Parses React and React Native components to document props contracts, hooks usage, and component hierarchy.

*Default:* `true`

generate_file_graph.title: Generate File Graph
generate_file_graph.description: Generate ASCII File Structure and Module Dependency Graph.
generate_file_graph.markdownDescription:
Builds an ASCII directory tree along with an import/export module dependency graph.

*Default:* `true`

defaultSnippets.label: Complete Configuration
defaultSnippets.description: Production setup with AI summarization and full structural analysis enabled.

defaultSnippets.label: Minimal Configuration
defaultSnippets.description: Minimal configuration relying on standard defaults.
